nodes.name: Lead intake
nodes.notes: POST from Next.js /api/ai-systems/leads. Activate this workflow and set N8N_WEBHOOK_URL to the Production webhook URL.

nodes.name: Qualify with Claude
nodes.notes: Uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the n8n environment. Scoring failure still continues to the outbound call.

nodes.name: Place Vapi call
nodes.notes: Transient assistant. firstMessage is the Fla. Stat. § 934.03 disclosure and must stay first. Vapi cloud posts status to Next.js, not localhost n8n.

nodes.name: Wait two rings
nodes.notes: About two rings (~6s each). Then inspect the Vapi call.
